messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGING: rapid TPM surge detected for model-family 'orion-7b' (tp95 token/sec ~6x baseline). Auto-sculpt triggered and some low-tier customers seeing 503/timeout errors. Root alert 1832104321.
sarah: on it, pulling logs from ingress and serving. which regions? seeing spikes in us-east-1 and eu-west-1.
mike-oncall: i'm taking this. quick check: are we seeing KV cache pressure or just bursty traffic? sarah, paste the top query hashes.
sarah: top queries look like prompt-expansions from a gaming app, lots of long context (~4k tokens) causing long tail token generation. KV hit rate dropping. stack traces show downstream timeouts at tokenizer and grpc stalls.
mike-oncall: plan: 1) rapid per-family quota reduction for orion-7b to blunt token rate, 2) disable function-calling for public tiers on orion-7b (it's amplifying token generation), 3) allowlist premium customers and keep them at higher quotas, 4) monitor errors and revoke if necessary.
carla: +1 on allowlist. we should avoid full family shutoff if possible; major customers still relying on it.
jamal: flagging fallback model path: route non-allowlist traffic to 'zephyr-3b' lower-cost family if quotas hit. that should reduce token-per-request.
mike-oncall: executing quota change now (will roll out with 60s grace). commands:
```
# admin CLI - internal
redwoodctl traffic set-quota --family orion-7b --tpm 200 --rpm 50 --scope public --reason "rapid shaping - surge" --ticket INC-4521
```
carla: recommend also lowering burst window to avoid token storms: set burst_tokens=100 for public.
mike-oncall: applying burst change too:
```
redwoodctl traffic set-quota --family orion-7b --burst 100 --scope public --ticket INC-4521
```
ops: respond: OK - changes accepted, patch id qc-1832-4521, rolling across regions.
ben: watching dashboards - querying metrics: error_rate_5m for public orion-7b peaked at 18% then down to 11% after first region patch. token throughput dropped ~62% in patched partitions.
mike-oncall: disable function-calling on public:
```
redwoodctl feature-toggle set --family orion-7b --feature function_calling --enabled false --scope public --reason "reduce token amplification during surge" --ticket INC-4521
```
support-bot: Noted. feature toggle applied. public function_calling disabled for orion-7b.
carla: are premium customers covered by allowlist? we need to whitelist customer IDs for support and enterprise. list: CUST-984, CUST-201, CUST-774.
mike-oncall: adding allowlist entries:
```
redwoodctl traffic allowlist add --family orion-7b --customers CUST-984,CUST-201,CUST-774 --tpm 1200 --rpm 300 --ticket INC-4521
```
jamal: routing fallback - apply traffic-split rule so that when family throttle hits, non-allowlist flows get routed to zephyr-3b at 70% probability.
```
redwoodctl routing set-split --from-family orion-7b --to-family zephyr-3b --when-throttled true --percent 70 --ticket INC-4521
```
ben: quick validation: curl internal health endpoints - tokenizer latency improved 40% in us-east-1 after quota + feature toggle. consumer-facing 503s decreased ~45%. still seeing a small cluster of persistent errors for a single API key (investigating).
sarah: that key belongs to a very chatty integration - rate-limited them and left a note to their team.
mike-oncall: posting short status in #customer-facing: "Temporary rate limits applied to orion-7b due to traffic surge; premium customers unaffected. We're routing fallback traffic to zephyr-3b. Monitoring and will update." carla, want to craft wording?
carla: sending now. keep it concise and note ETA for next update (30m). :thumbsup:
mike-oncall: running final checks: logs show no new grpc timeouts in last 2m, error rate trending down. retaining quota changes for 30 minutes then reassess.
ben: added anomaly watch for token-per-request spike and per-key repeated long-context patterns. if we see sustained <10% error rate we can widen quotas.
sanjay: i'll be the evening handoff. mike, please include runbook link and current mitigations in handoff message.
mike-oncall: handoff note: reduced public orion-7b tpm->200/rpm->50, burst_tokens=100, function_calling disabled for public, allowlist for premium customers added, routing-split to zephyr-3b at 70% when throttled. monitoring dashboards + runbook https://internal/runbooks/orion-throttle. last checked 1832105589.
carla: tagging PagerDuty on-call for night: @sanjay :wave: - if error rate rises >8% for more than 10m revert to partial carveout plan B (increase zephyr capacity + temporary extra nodes).
mike-oncall: creating post-incident ticket INC-4521 with timeline and commands used. will include recommended follow-ups: refine per-family surge policies, tighten function-calling cost heuristics, and add automated allowlist paths for high-value customers.
jamal: one more ask - persist a snapshot of the offending prompts to eval corpus so Research can add a quality/regression check to avoid future traffic amplification.
ben: noted. Archiving top-100 prompts to s3://incidents/INC-4521/prompts.txt.
support-bot: customer-facing update posted and pinged customers affected.
mike-oncall: closing active pager for now. monitor for 60m. handoff to @sanjay at 14:30 UTC. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
